# Skia markup reference

Fluent extensions declared by the `Aprillz.MewUI.Skia` package.

### SkiaCanvasView

Receiver: `SkiaCanvasView` and derived types (`where T : SkiaCanvasView`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Background(Color? value)` | `Background` | Sets the color the canvas is cleared with before painting; null clears to transparent, and a fully opaque color allows the faster non-blended present. |
| `ContinuousAnimation(bool value = true)` | `ContinuousAnimation` | Sets whether the control invalidates itself at the end of each render so animated Skia content keeps repainting without a render request; the default is true. |
| `OnPaintSurface(Action<SKCanvas, SKImageInfo> handler)` | `event PaintSurface` | Subscribes handler to PaintSurface. Occurs on each render pass with the Skia canvas sized to the current bounds. |
